name: DuoStatusBar
author: Muzi
description:
Merges the iPhone status bar's battery, Wi-Fi and cellular signal icons into a single circular widget in the style of the iPhone Duo outer display.

v20 changes:
- Switched to STUIStatusBar-native hook (port from 34306/DuoBar) so the indicator actually lives inside the system status bar rather than being a separate overlay window. Result: no more flash on Control Center / lock screen.
- Smart-invert: the icon now reads the resolved foreground colour from the system's own STUIStatusBarSignalStrengthItemView.activeColor (or the label/text view, or the bar's own foregroundColor), so it auto-inverts against any wallpaper like the rest of the status bar. Works for colour tints too, not just b/w.

Settings: position offsets, icon size, ring width, per-element HEX colours, debug log.
changelog:
v1.1.2 (2026-09-14)
- Cellular glyph fix: the LTE / 5G / antenna SF Symbol was being drawn with [state wifiColorForConnected:NO] (tint × 0.30 alpha, intended for the dimmed-wifi look). Now uses -resolvedTint, so the cellular symbol renders at full strength and follows the smart-invert colour like the rest of the icon.
- Declared -resolvedTint on DUOStatusBarState public interface.

v1.1.1 (2026-09-14)
- Smart-invert hotfix: read STUIStatusBarSignalStrengthItemView.activeColor / STUIStatusBarStringView.textColor / STUIStatusBar.foregroundColor (in that priority).
- Resolve all dynamic UIColor values against the screen traitCollection before passing them to CoreGraphics (DUOStatusBarState -resolve: helper).

v1.1.0 (2026-09-14)
- STUIStatusBar-native hook (port from 34306/DuoBar).
- Airplane-mode indicator hook.
- Deprecated DUOStatusBarOverlay class.

v1.0.0
- Initial release (UIWindow overlay).
